notes.title: The Bus DLC – Hamburg City – New Neighborhoods in Hamburg City
notes.content:
[h3]The Bus DLC – Hamburg City – New Residential Buildings for the Northern Expansion[/h3][p]With the free extension of bus lines 6 and 17 to the north, new residential areas are also arriving in the game. Instead of dense inner-city blocks, you’ll now encounter more open neighborhoods featuring single-family homes, smaller apartment buildings, and even garden allotments – all in true North German style.[/p][p]To authentically recreate this variety, [i]The Bus[/i] makes use of so-called [b]Blueprints[/b]. These are modular construction kits within Unreal Engine that allow objects to be assembled from many individual parts.
We’ve already used this method to create numerous variations of shelters and signposts – and now buildings are joining the lineup.[/p][p]For the northern expansion, we’ve developed two brand-new Blueprints:[/p][list][*][p][b]Residential Houses:[/b] Different building shapes, roof types, doors, windows, façade colors, and extras like balconies or solar panels ensure that every house is unique.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Garden Allotments:[/b] No two sheds look the same here either. Thanks to the special Blueprint, countless variations of small garden houses appear – just like you’d find in Hamburg’s neighborhoods.[/p][/*][/list][p]The advantage: while creating a Blueprint takes a little longer, it allows us to generate a huge variety of new objects in no time. This not only adds variety and saves development effort but also brings the northern districts of Hamburg to life with a realistic look.[/p][p]At the end of this post, you’ll find some work-in-progress images showing just how different these procedurally built houses can appear. You’ll soon spot them along the new lines 7 and 277.[/p][p]And don’t forget:
The big [b]Aerosoft Publisher Sale[/b] runs until September 23, 2025, 7 PM CEST!
You can grab [i]The Bus DLC – Hamburg City[/i] with a [b]25% discount[/b] – a great chance to experience virtual Hamburg. All upcoming line expansions are, of course, included for free.[/p][p][b]Stay up to date:[/b]
Follow us on Facebook or subscribe to our newsletter. For instant updates, join our Telegram channel and get all the news directly on your smartphone.[/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy your time in Hamburg![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Steam Store Page[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3544250/The_Bus__Hamburg_City_by_Halycon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Bus DLC Hamburg City – Update 1
notes.content:
[p][b]The Bus DLC – Hamburg City: New version now available on Steam[/b][/p][p]A new version of our popular Hamburg City DLC for [i]The Bus[/i] is now available for download on Steam.
This update brings initial optimisations and adjustments to the Hamburg map.
Existing installations can easily be updated via Steam.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629408/f9795338c802f5db24281cbac00420833dbf44da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the ongoing improvement of the map and testing of new main game features such as AI buses, we are already working intensively on upcoming expansions.
More on this very soon.
One current focus is the different lamp types that have been individually modelled for Hamburg – these will be added to the game shortly.[/p][p][b]Changelog of the current version:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revised parking at Goldbekplatz[/p][/*][*][p]Added lighting to underground entrances at Steinstraße and Hauptbahnhof[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted road traffic between Zimmerstraße and Averhoffstraße[/p][/*][*][p]Added footprints for AI pedestrians in certain areas[/p][/*][*][p]Various smaller optimisations[/p][/*][*][p]Additional bus stop positions for creating your own routes:[/p][list][*][p]Hauptbahnhof/ZOB[/p][/*][*][p]Kurt-Schumacher-Allee (towards Hauptbahnhof)[/p][/*][*][p]Arrival stop Brandstwiete[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Installation note[/b]
If the update does not start automatically:
Simply go to your Steam library, click on [i]Downloads[/i], and then press the download button next to [i]The Bus[/i].[/p][p][b]Important note:[/b]
[b]The Hamburg City DLC can only be displayed correctly with the retail version of [i]The Bus[/i].
You should by no means play the DLC with [i]The Bus[/i] Beta 3.2, as this will inevitably cause errors.[/b][/p]

notes.title: The Bus - Update 1.1 BETA
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629408/a85bd0593a01b14e38888f348a9727b07ef3d783.jpg[/img]

We just released our first beta update for The Bus!
One week after the start of the early access, we gathered, thanks to our community, lots and lots of feedback and bug reports. We were not able to implement everything right now, but we've got your suggestions on our list. You can see the complete changelog below:

---
[b]Please create backup copies of your savegame files before switching to EA BETA Update 1. Savegames may not be compatible with the new version of the game.[/b]
---

[b]ATTENTION: This is a BETA update. Technical problems, instability of the game as well as bugs during gameplay can be possible.[/b]
How to install the beta version of the update?
Quite easily:
In your Library, you click with the right mouse button on the entry of the "The Bus"
In the drop-menu, you click on the entry "Properties"
In the window "The Bus - Properties" you select the tab "BETAS"
In the field "Select the beta you would like to opt into:" select the entry "beta-"
Now you can close the window and the beta version of the update should download right away
After downloading the update you can start The Bus via the "PLAY" button
In the main menu should now be the corresponding version number of the beta version of the update and you can test the update


---
[b]Changelog 0.5.40451 EA[/b]
[list]
[*] Compatibility with Windows 7 and DirectX improved
[*] Fixed some crashes caused by the in-game editors
[*] Fixed some navigation errors
[*] Added option to disable the action camera (Options\Game\General\Show action camera)
[*] Some menus in screen resolutions of 4:3, 5:4 and 16:10 improved
[*] The field of view (FOV) can now be increased to 120 using the sliders
[*] With TrackIR active the mouse cursor can now be used
[*] Fixed blurry texture resolution of the small trucks
[*] Operating plan menu added, changes in the in-game editors can be reset here for the time being
[*] Passenger can now pay with more variety of hard money when buying tickets
[*] Fixed typo "Stehlplätzr" (=Standing room)
[*] Replaced billboards of Quadriga (Brandenburg Gate) and Viktoria (Victory Column) with actual 3d models
[*] Replaced statue on Unter den Linden with horseman statue
[*] Updated model of Brandenburg Gate
[*] Graphical bug fixes
[*] Fixed localization errors
[*] Added missing locations
[/list]

[b]Changelog 0.5.40521 EA[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed passengers blocking entry when the player continued driving but did not completed the passenger’s ticket sale*
[*] Fixed a typo in the German localisation of the menus*
[*] Passengers now walk up to the curbstone when their bus line approaches the stop
[*] ATM physics fixed
[*] [strike]Added license plates for parking cars[/strike]
[*] Radio now stops correctly when stopped and closed
[*] Passengers now wait for the doors to fully open before disembarking
[*] Public Feedback Reporter optimized
[*] Added off state to observation monitor
[*] Miscellaneous graphic fixes
[/list]

* An error that only occurred during the BETA test of this update
